research_question: Can a fixed eight-hour cross-sectional/time-series momentum router select the current crypto price-discovery market often enough to generate robust cost-positive day trades after a separate one-hour confirmation?

sources: crypto intraday continuation conditional on volume and volatility
reused: rank assets by prior completed returns rather than fixed symbol identity
require agreement between short and medium trend horizons
select the strongest market only after cross-market state routing
use a volatility trailing stop rather than a fixed profit target

scenario.context: every completed eight-hour boundary, compute trailing twenty-four-hour and seven-day returns from completed one-hour bars

state.BREADTH_TREND_LEADER: at least three markets agree in sign on both horizons; trade the strongest volatility-normalized market in the shared direction
state.CROSS_SECTIONAL_TREND_LEADER: breadth is unresolved; trade only the unique largest residual score whose own horizons agree

scenario.confirmation: the wholly subsequent completed one-hour bar extends in the proposed direction with directional body and taker pressure
scenario.invalidation: outside the confirmation-hour extreme plus half of prior twenty-four-hour ATR
scenario.management: trail the best completed hourly close by one and a half prior twenty-four-hour ATR
scenario.exit: trailing stop or before the next eight-hour decision boundary
scenario.arbitration: one selected market and one global open position

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: all state returns and ATR use completed one-hour bars ending at the decision boundary; entry follows a separately completed one-hour confirmation

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Only a fixed route positive in all declared splits advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not change horizons, decision clocks, ranking, confirmation or stop rules after evaluation.
